entries.261a3fbc4e33510b: This division, at the core of the printing business, handles everything from books, magazines and promotional materials to IC cards and payments, digital marketing, and event and store creation. Its offerings include books, magazines, textbooks and e-books; printed matter such as flyers, catalogues and calendars; BPO services that undertake corporate operations and contact centres; IC card, authentication and security products and services; sublimation-type and melt-type thermal transfer products; ID photo booths; and book sales and library operation. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥748,674 million (up 4.9% year on year), making it the largest of the company's three reportable segments. From the current period, a change in segment classification moved some equity-method affiliates from the 'adjustments' category into this division, and the prior-period figures have been restated under the revised classification. entries.2f48026df38bdac7: The company is executing a three-year medium-term management plan starting from the fiscal year beginning April 2026, and its business strategy calls for "expanding focus businesses and promoting structural reform." It designates information security-related, photo imaging-related, mobility-related, industrial high-functionality materials-related, digital interface-related and semiconductor-related businesses as "focus businesses," and states that it will invest actively in them. The company will strengthen profitability of the "foundation businesses" and the "restructuring businesses," and states that in the restructuring businesses it will consider reducing or withdrawing from products and services with limited room for growth. Businesses expected to grow in the future will be developed as "growth potential businesses," and the company positions medical and healthcare-related businesses as one of them. On the financial side, the company plans to create funds for growth investment by reducing assets such as cross-shareholdings and by compressing cash on hand, and to allocate them to capital expenditure and to M&A in focus businesses and their surrounding fields.

entries.fb598fc125c76f5e: This division makes products used in daily life and industry, from battery and solar cell components, food and pharmaceutical packaging, interior and exterior materials for homes and automobiles, and contract manufacturing of pharmaceuticals to beverages. It handles lithium-ion battery pouches, solar cell components, transparent barrier films, various packaging materials, cups, plastic bottles, laminate tubes, aseptic filling systems, interior and exterior materials for homes, stores, vehicles and home appliances, molded automotive parts, contract manufacturing of pharmaceutical intermediates and drugs, and beverages such as carbonated soft drinks and coffee drinks. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue from external customers was ¥512,092 million (up 3.3% year on year), making it the second-largest of the company's three reportable segments. It rose from ¥495,855 million in the previous year. Among its principal affiliates, Hokkaido Coca-Cola Bottling Co., Ltd. is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Sapporo Securities Exchange.

entries.fc808e23ad205c96: In January 2023, it established DNP Coalize Co., Ltd.
